name: Ansible Semaphore
description: Ansible Semaphore is a modern UI for Ansible. It lets you easily run Ansible playbooks, get notifications about fails, control access to deployment system.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Semaphore admin password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Mysql random root password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-semaphore application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-semaphore
  # The `big-bear-semaphore` service definition
  big-bear-semaphore:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-semaphore
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: semaphoreui/semaphore:v2.19.17@sha256:008dacd9f1adbd92e8a048f1786ae1dd9bed2a352aca2eb30b9837de5706e7f7
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Environment variables for configuration
    environment:
      SEMAPHORE_DB_USER: semaphore
      SEMAPHORE_DB_PASS: semaphore
      SEMAPHORE_DB_HOST: big-bear-semaphore-db
      SEMAPHORE_DB_PORT: "3306"
      SEMAPHORE_DB_DIALECT: mysql
      SEMAPHORE_DB: semaphore
      SEMAPHORE_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_SEMAPHORE_ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      SEMAPHORE_ADMIN_NAME: admin
      SEMAPHORE_ADMIN_EMAIL: admin@example.com
      SEMAPHORE_ADMIN: admin
      TZ: UTC
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/home:/etc/semaphore # Configuration files for Semaphore
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/lib:/var/lib/semaphore # Local storage for Semaphore data (not needed if using an external database)
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:3000" # Expose port 3000 for web access
    networks:
      - big-bear-semaphore-network
  # MySQL database service for semaphore
  big-bear-semaphore-db:
    container_name: big-bear-semaphore-db
    image: mysql:8.0@sha256:7dcddc01f13bab2f15cde676d44d01f61fc9f99fe7785e86196dfc07d358ae2b
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/mysql:/var/lib/mysql # Data directory for MySQL
    environment:
      MYSQL_RANDOM_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_MYSQL_RANDOM_ROOT_PASSWORD} # Generate a random root password
      MYSQL_DATABASE: "semaphore" # Database name to create
      MYSQL_USER: "semaphore" # Database user
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: "semaphore" # Database password
    networks:
      - big-bear-semaphore-network
networks:
  big-bear-semaphore-network:
    driver: bridge # Specifies network driver type
